proposal_title: Canonical Domain Model Provenance & Entity Completeness
domain_specific_rationale: As Data Architect, establishing the true immutable five-tier relational hierarchy (shots -> shot_versions -> prompt_versions -> generation_jobs -> takes) in PostgreSQL is foundational to relational consistency and forensic reproducibility. The previous schema inverted the parent-child relationship by placing prompt_version_id on ShotVersion and omitting shot_version_id from PromptVersion. CP-001 fixes this inversion: 1) Relational Lineage & Compound FKs: prompt_versions enforces FOREIGN KEY (shot_id, shot_version_id) REFERENCES shot_versions(shot_id, shot_version_id) and UNIQUE(shot_version_id, version_number), guaranteeing prompt variants compile from exactly one immutable creative intent revision without orphaned records or relational desynchronization; 2) Full Entity Completeness: Restoring creative direction fields (duration_ms, action_description, camera_motion, environment_settings, character_refs, style_refs, asset_refs, constraints, continuity_refs) to shot_versions, and provenance/rights metadata (source_type, license_type, rights_attribution, origin_uri, mime_type, byte_size, checksum_sha256) to asset_versions guarantees that every Take can be mathematically reconstructed back to its exact inputs, rights, and compiler decisions; 3) Technology Decoupling: Removing hardcoded constraints on face_embedding_hash and lora_weights_uri (placing them in optional custom_attributes) ensures schema flexibility across diverse AI generation backends without violating strict database typing; 4) RFC 4122 UUID typing guarantees uniform surrogate key validation across the PostgreSQL storage engine.
capability_impact: Directly safeguards CAP-01 (Canonical Core State), CAP-05 (Prompt Compiler), and CAP-06 (Assets & Continuity). Eliminates circular dependencies, enables immutable snapshot auditability, and enforces relational integrity across all production artifacts.
residual_risk: Schema migration scripts must establish composite unique constraints UNIQUE(shot_id, shot_version_id) and compound foreign keys in PostgreSQL transactional DDL during deployment. Handled via standard R02 database migration suite.
